sourceQualifications.qualification: The proposal follows the March 17, 2026 stepped 16-storey plan. The 48.15 m value is the top slab of the last residential floor, not ultimate roof height. Façades and the upper roof enclosure are inferred. The retained 13-storey apartment uses an approximate 39.12 m roof and photo-informed balconies. Current approval, delivery and as-built measurements remain unconfirmed; placement has about 3 m working uncertainty.
